## Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have been marked by a significant shift in the U.S.-Iran conflict, with Washington lifting its naval blockade and seeking $80 billion in supplemental funding for the war. Simultaneously, global naval modernization accelerates—Russia's nuclear cruiser *Admiral Nakhimov* nears return, India eyes a 1,500-km BrahMos missile, and the U.S. Army stands up a new drone-centric unit for the Pacific. Tensions in the Taiwan Strait and South China Sea persist, with China conducting military drills in the Beibu Gulf and releasing first footage of the DF-17 hypersonic missile test. 

- **Iran Conflict Cooling?** The U.S. [ended its naval blockade of Iran](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran) on June 18, signing a 60-day MOU with Tehran. However, the Pentagon [told lawmakers it needs $80 billion](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/19/pentagon-tells-lawmakers-it-needs-80-billion-for-iran-war-other-expenses-wsj/) for the Iran war and related expenses, signaling the conflict's cost remains opaque. President Trump [hopes to put the war in the “rearview mirror”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9VT1pHX2pPM0VfUEpBRE03d21OVHNsbG81Q2REd29uWnhXSGJMQ0FVQVNxMFBHYUplY3lJeUg2eV9faTZiMUtYNHlGel9xZVI1T0djSEl2RUl1akl6M1BEd0xxcmVPbDlQMjkxRW1RdE8taWt2VXZz), but the risk of Hormuz closure [threatens oil markets](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQbUlEMXZScFd1STZGeHNUekc4WEJIbXYxMWxmNnZabExxMXpjdmVCd0R5cy0xMGJZaG9IaXV0RENncnpSWUNUNDFlV3pScTJFanBxN3d1cDRCUGpIRG0yNFdZTjdSTGJzMTU2VHl5ell3OXpxajZQNWVFRlUzN19Zdm1mZUtSTm41MWZIT0N5LW9LRnl2X0dHV0JIZmhNdU1DV3V1NQ). 
- **Russia's Nuclear Cruiser Returns**: The [*Admiral Nakhimov*](https://news.google.) is nearing completion of its multi-year refit; its return restores Russia's heavy nuclear-powered surface combatant presence at sea, a 'Death Star' with strategic weight. 
- **India's Deep-Strike Ambitions**: [BrahMos Aerospace](https://news.google.) proposes a 1,500-km supersonic cruise missile variant, significantly extending India's precision-strike reach. 
- **U.S. Pacific Drone Warfare**: The Army's new [7th Infantry Division Multi-Domain Command – Pacific](https://www.twz.com/air/armys-newest-unit-wants-to-overwhelm-adversaries-with-drones-in-pacific-fight) aims to 'overwhelm' adversaries with drones integrated with Stryker brigades. Separately, [RC-135 Rivet Joints could control drones](https://www.twz.com/air/rc-135-rivet-joints-could-control-drones-to-drastically-expand-collection-capabilities) to expand ISR capabilities. 
- **China Displays DF-17**: [State media released first footage of the DF-17 hypersonic missile test](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1Od3JWZlg1SzhYZW82eUM3bUxmU1NxcDF6YUs0MmFxd0c3ekp3UDdQc2l4YzJVOF9aQnVrM1NvdW52Um4xMlFSV1hmOVhFd0RSNGdRWXR4Z045NGJzYUQyeEJVdTZlS3BmbUE), a signal of capability as Taiwan's opposition party [proposes defense budget cuts](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNY1RsckpZdWVOZEVUcDVvUEZuSm9zLUEzcUhiMGw2OWNORWRnT041MFlZSFV3amNLNldFTEVnQTBlQUQ1YUdRcDg4UEtaOGpKdE8wdV9wRVdTcXZGZ004blhCaWhHRFRkZEpuai1nOElMYTZtZHl1QklXaDVCVWU3ZEVaY29icWJHNjJv), drawing U.S. criticism.

- **UK Unmanned Fleet Seeks Missile Launchers**: [Britain is seeking launchers for its crewless warship fleet](https://news.google.), a key enabler for distributed maritime operations. 

**Watch next:** The U.S.-Iran 60-day MOU window will test diplomatic endurance, while RIMPAC 2026 kicks off June 24—watch for allied naval exercises. China's Beibu Gulf drills may signal further SCS activity.
